title: Official: Ford’s $29,495 Small EV Truck Is Called Fathom, Not Ranchero
excerpt: Ford's new electric pickup is almost the same price as Maverick—but is its name going to be a problem?
content_html:
Enough speculation has swirled about Ford’s forthcoming small all-electric pickup truck to fill the bed of an F-350 Super Duty. Today, the Blue Oval lightens that payload somewhat by officially announcing the new EV truck’s name and starting price, while confirming additional tech and capabilities.

This Goes Deep

“Ranchero” had been our guess at the truck’s title, but instead, an entirely new nameplate will be introduced. So here it is: Ford Fathom.

That aligns with the alliterative nomenclature Ford has used in the past with vehicles such as the Fusion, Focus, and Flex. There’s punny meaning behind the name, too. Ford said that in developing the truck it “reached a new depth of innovation, allowing the company to fathom possibilities once thought beyond reach.”

On learning the name, several MotorTrend staffers expressed their bewilderment with Ford’s choice, potentially portending a wider public reaction. But Fathom is official, and will designate what might be the most disruptive Ford since the F-150 Lightning.

Shallow Pockets? Here’s Your Truck

Perhaps any consternation around the name will fade when considering the starting price. The Fathom will begin at $29,945 ($28,350 plus a $1,595 destination fee).

That pricing is with the standard-range lithium-ion phosphate (LFP) battery, which is of an unknown size. Ford confirmed that it will offer a larger pack, extending driving range for extra cost. The entry-level Fathom will be rear-wheel drive, propelled by a permanent-magnet motor designed and built by Ford. An all-wheel-drive setup that adds an induction motor to the front axle will also be available.

This sub-$30,000 starting price demonstrates Ford’s obsession with manufacturing efficiency in developing the Universal Electric Vehicle Platform that underpins the Fathom and other future EVs. For example, the architecture uses large aluminum unicastings to incorporate more than 100 parts that would otherwise be separate, which simultaneously reduces the amount of fasteners used. Rather than a distinct floor component, the Fathom’s interior parts mount directly to the top of the structural battery.

For comparison, the Fathom’s $29,495 base price makes it roughly $20,000 less expensive than the cheapest versions of the F-150 Lightning in its final year of production. It’s barely more expensive than the 2026 Ford Maverick, which starts at $29,685 for the XL trim with front-wheel drive and no options. A potential rival is the Slate Truck, which starts at just $26,400—but that might be a weaker value given the Fathom’s features.

content_html_zh:
人们对福特即将推出的小型全电动皮卡车的猜测已经足够多，该卡车将填补 F-350 Super Duty 的空间。 今天，Blue Oval 正式宣布了新型电动卡车的名称和起价，同时确认了其他技术和功能，从而在一定程度上减轻了有效载荷。

这很深入

“Ranchero”是我们对卡车名称的猜测，但相反，我们将推出一个全新的铭牌。 这就是：福特噚。

这与福特过去在 Fusion、Focus 和 Flex 等车辆上使用的头韵命名法是一致的。 这个名字背后也有双关含义。 福特表示，在开发这款卡车的过程中，它“达到了新的创新深度，让公司能够探索曾经被认为遥不可及的可能性。”

在得知这个名字后，几位 MotorTrend 员工表达了他们对福特的选择的困惑，这可能预示着更广泛的公众反应。 但 Fathom 已正式发布，并将指定福特自 F-150 Lightning 以来最具颠覆性的车型。

口袋浅？ 这是你的卡车

也许当考虑到起价时，围绕这个名字的任何惊愕都会消失。 Fathom 起价为 29,945 美元（28,350 美元加上 1,595 美元的目的地费）。

该定价适用于标准范围的锂离子磷酸盐 (LFP) 电池，其尺寸未知。 福特确认将提供更大的电池组，以延长行驶里程，但需额外付费。 入门级 Fathom 将采用后轮驱动，由福特设计和制造的永磁电机驱动。 还将提供在前轴上添加感应电机的全轮驱动装置。

这个低于 30,000 美元的起价表明福特在开发支持 Fathom 和其他未来电动汽车的通用电动汽车平台时对制造效率的痴迷。 例如，该架构使用大型铝制单铸件来整合 100 多个原本需要分开的部件，同时减少了紧固件的使用量。 Fathom 的内部部件不是一个独特的地板组件，而是直接安装在结构电池的顶部。

相比之下，Fathom 的基本价格为 29,495 美元，比 F-150 Lightning 最后一年生产的最便宜版本便宜约 20,000 美元。 它只比 2026 款福特 Maverick 贵一点点，后者的 XL 版起价为 29,685 美元，配备前轮驱动且没有选装件。 潜在的竞争对手是 Slate Truck，起价仅为 26,400 美元，但考虑到 Fathom 的功能，这个价格可能会较低。
